pins that the WaveRow.svelte static-repaint effect reads bandGains; rendering WaveRow needs a live canvas and the engine store, and the band-gain paint itself is covered by the rendered drawWaveRow tests in the same file (WAVE-EQ-5230)

LIBM-185: pins that nine img sites carry data-expected-resource-error, call the shared coverFailed/coverVisible helpers and keep no private failed flag; a markup attribute and call-site contract across Mixer, TrackTable, dedup and others that an SSR render of one component cannot see, and the retry logic itself is tested on the extracted helper in the same file

Pins the Knob/ChannelStrip pointer wiring (capture-phase document listener, ontap on release, no native select) and the caption CSS (ellipsis, max-width, 8px size); the CSS is scoped style text and the handlers need real pointer events, neither of which an SSR render runs, and the press classifier itself is tested as an exported function in the same file

Pins the Deck and DeckHeader mirror CSS (row-reverse scoped to the mirror class, no scaleX or rtl flip); scoped style rules are not in SSR output and Deck needs the whole engine context to render, so the layout contract can only be read from source until a browser layout test exists

Two pins read LibrarySourceTabs (hover-intent handlers, popover not pointer-events: none) and BrowserPanel (removes rows in place, never _loadPane); event handlers and CSS do not run in an SSR render and BrowserPanel is too large to render in a unit test; the history rows, jump parsing and removeRowsInPlace logic are tested as exported functions in the same file

Pins TrackTable row-press and dragend wiring, the multi-select load-box hiding CSS, the 200ms remove/restore animation CSS and BrowserPanel toast wiring; handlers and scoped CSS do not run in an SSR render and TrackTable and BrowserPanel are too heavy to render in a unit test; the inverse-row and restore logic is tested as exported functions in the same file

One test pins TrackLoadResetPanel (testid, resetDeckNowCommand dispatch, secondary-button CSS with no accent) and that Deck and ChannelStrip toggle the panel; the click dispatch and scoped CSS are not exercised by an SSR render, while the command parsing and dispatch are tested through the real performance-ipc module in the same file

KEY-CELL-01: pins the empty key/BPM status spans in TrackTable markup and the key hover card note binding; the status spans are only reached for a failed row inside the virtualised table, which an SSR render of TrackTable does not populate

KEY-GUESS-01: pins that the key-guess span carries no title= and that keyCellTitle writes the best-guess line into the hover card note; the note is a prop bound on hover, which an SSR render never triggers

PLAYLIST-ROW-01: pins the LibrarySourceTabs undo button focus handlers (keyboard focus opens history, mouse focus does not, hover intent still does); focus and pointer handlers do not run in an SSR render
